Omarchy vs gnomarchi

Side-by-side from live VMs on 2026-10-20. Omarchy 4.0.6 stable qcow2 (Hyprland+Quickshell) vs gnomarchi test VM (GNOME Shell 51 + overlay).

Omarchy SSH :2223 / VNC :5902 gnomarchi SSH :2222 / VNC :5901 Venue 1920×1080 Source: nightly.omarchy.org stable 4.0.6

Summary

gnomarchi tracks Omarchy’s product surface (themes, menu, agents, oma*/gnoma* apps, bar position, capture) on GNOME+Arch instead of Hyprland+Quickshell. Visual language is close on wallpaper/theme packs; chrome differs (GNOME top bar vs Quickshell; Ghostty vs foot; floating vs tiled gaps).

Themes

Omarchy ships 22 packs under /usr/share/omarchy/themes. gnomarchi lists 24 (adds midnight-harbor, starship). Shared names: catppuccin, catppuccin-latte, ethereal, everforest, flexoki-light, gruvbox, hackerman, kanagawa, last-horizon, lumon, lupine, matte-black, miasma, nord, osaka-jade, retro-82, ristretto, rose-pine, solitude, tokyo-night, vantablack, white.

Both VMs were on Tokyo Night during capture; Omarchy theme bg next rotated to a car/sunset art pack mid-session.

Left = original Omarchy VM. Right = gnomarchi parity-v2. Images are 960px JPEG thumbs embedded for offline viewing; full PNGs live under docs/screenshots/omarchy-v1/ and docs/screenshots/parity-v2/.

Method

  • Omarchy: downloaded omarchy-4.0.6.qcow2 (sha256 verified) + unpacked vm-boot; QEMU KVM 8G/4cpu; VNC 127.0.0.1:2; forced Virtual-1,1920x1080@60 via ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua.
  • gnomarchi: existing gnomarchi-test VM; shots from docs/screenshots/parity-v2/ (re-audited checklist).
  • Capture: host vncdotool against each VNC; guest actions via SSH with systemd user env (OMARCHY_PATH).
